planets.name: TOI-1470 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1470 with a 18.1-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1470 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1470. Its orbit and size follow González-Álvarez et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
